# MESH-PERF-3 local-only diagnostic overlay

This directory does not patch root `carrier/` or install anything. The overlay is
against the **231-file accepted gateway inventory**, not main. See the
[report](../../../docs/releases/2026-10-18-mesh-perf-3.md) for exact hashes, failed
development tests, passing final tests and the blocked physical handoff.

Required local inputs are retained under
`state-client-build/transport-write-batching-1/`. Preparation validates every source
hash and the accepted binary. The retained Go1.26.1 toolchain/module cache is used;
GOPROXY/GOSUMDB are off. No production credentials are needed for local tests.

## Reproduce without overwriting evidence

Choose a fresh absolute local output path. The default original evidence directory
is exclusive-create and must not be overwritten. For example, from repository root:

```sh
export REPO="$PWD"
export MESH_PERF3_OUT=/tmp/fc-mesh-perf3-reproduction
python3 tests/fixtures/mesh_perf3/prepare.py
cd "$MESH_PERF3_OUT/source/carrier"
patch -p1 --dry-run < "$REPO/tests/fixtures/mesh_perf3/accepted-overlay.patch"
patch -p1 < "$REPO/tests/fixtures/mesh_perf3/accepted-overlay.patch"
cd "$REPO"
python3 tests/fixtures/mesh_perf3/run_local.py race candidate test -p=1 -race \
  -tags=fc_perf_diagnostic ./reliablestream ./tcpforward ./sessiontrace \
  ./familysession ./sessiondiag ./telemost ./roombroker -count=1 -json
python3 tests/fixtures/mesh_perf3/run_local.py layer-local-off candidate test -p=1 \
  ./tcpforward -run '^TestMeshPerformanceMatrix$/(reliable|family|mux)/(384|16384)/download/1$' -count=3 -json
python3 tests/fixtures/mesh_perf3/run_local.py layer-local-on candidate test -p=1 \
  -tags=fc_perf_diagnostic ./tcpforward \
  -run '^TestMeshPerformanceMatrix$/(reliable|family|mux)/(384|16384)/download/1$' -count=3 -json
python3 tests/fixtures/mesh_perf3/run_local.py diagnostic-build candidate build \
  -p=1 -trimpath -buildvcs=false -tags=fc_perf_diagnostic \
  -o "$MESH_PERF3_OUT/diagnostic-broker" ./cmd/bootstrap-broker
```

Use a new receipt label for each command. Loopback socket/race fixtures may need
execution outside the CLI network sandbox. Live FC/YANDEX flags are stripped by
the runner. Labels starting `layer-` opt into the existing **local synthetic**
matrix, fixed40ms one-way model delay,256KiB Mux body and existing trace enabled.
No provider/cloud/Android traffic is generated by those tests.

For exact baseline wire/microbench comparisons, copy accepted `carrier/` into
`$MESH_PERF3_OUT/baseline-test` and copy only
`reliablestream/performance_common_test.go` and
`tcpforward/mesh_performance_test.go` from the candidate into the corresponding
test directories. Use runner mode `baseline-test`. Mode `baseline` reads the
unaltered accepted source directly. Neither modifies it.

The readback scripts are separately executed **read-only operational helpers**,
not part of reproduction: they use the authorized RU/NL hosts and existing ADB,
never service mutations, and store only bounded safe metadata. Do not run them
merely to reproduce local fixtures. `seal.py` is the original task's exclusive
evidence packager; its existing evidence/patch outputs are immutable.

## Metric contract

- Size bins have inclusive upper bounds512,1024,2048,4096,8192,16384; last is overflow.
- Duration upper bounds:1,5,20,80,200,500,1000,5000ms; last is overflow. Stored units
  are nanoseconds. Event `NodeNS` is relative to a process-local monotonic origin;
  never subtract values from different processes/nodes.
- Window/media rings retain128 entries each. `EventCount`/`Count` expose overwrite;
  ring index is `(count-1)%128`. Retired Mux ring holds64 entries. No complete
  per-packet history is promised.
- `NewDATA` counts engine submissions; `CarrierAcceptedDATA` counts successful
  carrier enqueue attempts, including retries. `EnqueuedRetainedBytes` is neither
  media queue size nor network bytes in flight.
- ReadyFullNS may overlap writer work. WindowOnlyBlockedNS excludes that overlap.
  FullNS without ready data is not proof of throughput restriction.
- Mux QueuedDATA and HandedDATA differ: the former is queued in Write; the latter
  is a successful Family send return, not remote application delivery. Per-stream
  zero-credit-ready and queue-ready durations can overlap and must not be summed.
- FirstACKNoRetry includes local delivery and ACK-return delay; ReleaseNoRetry may
  additionally include receive/consume delay. Recovery variants are not RTT samples.
- Existing public SessionTrace schemas are untouched. The diagnostic gateway uses
  its existing two-second sampler/correlated session tag to emit a separate bounded
  metadata envelope. No per-packet log sink or payload tracing is added.

A future authorized collector must retain `restricted_performance_v1` as well as
the existing `restricted_trace` events, then join by the existing session tag.
The bulk-1 collector's original CARRIER_ACTIVITY-only filter is insufficient for
this new envelope. Preserve counter deltas and ring-overwrite counts; never turn
missing ring entries into zero latency or zero retransmissions. No physical
collection with this format has been accepted yet.

There is deliberately no remote deploy/start command or UI84 selector here.
Physical execution remains blocked until a supported, separately reviewed owner
handoff exists. Do not replace the general gateway to work around that gate.
